title: Haray Dhaniay ki Chutney (Green Coriander Chutney)

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: The author's mother's simple, bright green chutney. Subcontinental chutneys are raw, hot-sauce-like condiments eaten a little at a time with the meal. A few mint leaves can go in too.

steps.action: Blend, adding a little water if needed (push down with a spoon only while the blender is off):
items: 1 cup loosely packed cilantro, roughly chopped, stems included

steps.action: Taste a tiny bit; adjust salt, sugar, and lime.
Store refrigerated up to a week:
items: If it dries out, stir in a little water
